timezone_evidence.why: all 50 funding rows read 03:00/11:00/19:00, so the CSV clock is 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC shifted by +3h (mod 8h the candidates are -5h, +3h and +11h; only the phase is pinned). +3h is adopted because the commit author timezone of this repository is +0300 and neither -5h nor +11h is a plausible account timezone for this ledger. Both the +3h and the +0h readings are nevertheless computed end to end and reported.

counts.committed_docstring_claim: test_3_binance_replay.py calls the archive 'the user's 257 trades'; 257 is the position-cycle count

definitions.entry: a fill that OPENS a position (previous position flat) or ADDS to it (same side, larger absolute size); reduces/closes/flips are not entries
definitions.primary_test_unit: kind == 'open' (one per flat->flat cycle); 'add' fills are a separately labelled secondary block because an add is conditional on a position that is already working
definitions.as_of: last 1m bar stamped floor(entry_time_utc,'1min') - 1min, i.e. the last bar that had closed strictly before the entry; no entry-bar or later data feeds any indicator

actual_fill_price.note: the trader's real traded price; the only tradable reference. Real entries only - a random control has no fill price.

open_of_fill_bar.note: open of the 1m bar containing the fill. Observable for both real and control, but it is the price one minute BEFORE the print, so it credits the entry with drift that a taker could not have captured.

close_of_fill_bar.note: close of the 1m bar containing the fill; strictly at or after the fill.

next_bar_open.note: open of the first bar that begins after the fill bar; strictly after the fill.

definitions.forward_move_bps: side * (endpoint / reference - 1) * 1e4, before fees; side = +1 for a BUY entry, -1 for a SELL entry
definitions.daily_trend_ema20: +1 if the last COMPLETED daily close > its daily EMA20 else -1
definitions.daily_trend_c2c: +1 if the last COMPLETED daily close > the previous daily close else -1
definitions.control: 1000 independent random timestamp sets; one control per real entry, matched on (symbol, side, hour-of-day UTC), drawn with replacement from 1m bars inside the symbol's own trading window +/- 1 day, requiring 300 bars of warmup and 60 bars of forward data
definitions.hypothesis_test: two-sided; p_two_sided_empirical = (1 + #{|null set mean - null mean| >= |real - null mean|}) / (1 + N_SETS); diff_ci95 combines the bootstrap SE of the real mean with the SD of the set means
definitions.multiple_testing: Holm step-down within each family: 13 indicator conditions, and the 4 horizons within each forward-reference block

assumptions: A 1m bar stamped T covers [T, T+1m) and closes at T+1m, so the last closed bar before an entry at T is stamped floor(T,'1min') - 1min.
Only the single 1m bar that contained each fill is observable; 15s charts cannot be rebuilt from 1m data, so the intra-minute path is unknown and is only bracketed by the bar's open/close.
Control draws are with replacement and are not excluded from windows in which the account already held a position.
BNBUSDT has no 1m candle file, so its 2 cycles / 11 entries are excluded from every indicator and forward-return statistic; they are counted in counts.entries_excluded_no_1m_data.
